title: Fixed Cowled Tandem Cockpit And Four Runner Bobsled
description: One newly authored complete empty cowled tandem-seat bobsled exterior. A continuous thick closed-bottom shell joins a broad raised foredeck to a rearward oval cockpit with full inner walls and floor. Two complete low cushions with inclined back pads lie inside the cockpit. Two separate transverse underbody beams carry four independent short upturned blade runners through four complete pedestals; four body mounts join these beams into the shell underside. Unlike the complete wooden sled with five open planks and two continuous long runners, this entire vehicle has a deep integral cockpit and broad closed nose cowling on four short separated blades. Unlike the complete snowmobile, it has no track, straddle saddle, motor hood or ski steering arms. Every coordinate is newly authored with no old mesh extracted or imported. One prop zero scenes, metre units Z up, four opaque constant PBR roles. Empty static decorative game art, no people. Fixed overlaps are visual roots, not working bearings. No sliding, steering, braking, aerodynamics, speed, rider fit, load, ice or snow compatibility, manufacture, operation or safety capability. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
